package.description: A Windows/Mac application that validates and confirms that the recordings and screenshots made by Synology Surveillance Station have not been tampered with since its original recording.

en-US.description: A Windows/Mac application that validates and confirms that the recordings and screenshots made by Synology Surveillance Station have not been tampered with since its original recording.
en-US.longDescription: Synology Evidence Integrity Authenticator is a Windows/Mac application that validates and confirms that the recordings and screenshots made by Synology Surveillance Station have not been tampered with since its original recording. Other than approve the recordings’ embedded digital signature, this tool also display the exact recording time and DiskStation serial number.
en-US.name: Synology Evidence Integrity Authenticator

zh-CN.description: 在多平台上（Windows/Mac）验证摄影或快照是否由 Synology 的 Surveillance Station 所产出，确保图像或录像文件未经过人为修改。
zh-CN.longDescription: Synology Evidence Integrity Authenticator 提供了使用者在多平台上(Windows/Mac)，验证摄影或快照是否由 Synology 的 Surveillance Station 所产出，确保图像或录像文件未经过人为修改。验证后录像文件后，会显示确切的录像时间和进行录像的 DiskStation 型号。
